darkness.line: And in my hour of darkness
stanza: When I find myself in times of trouble
Mother Mary comes to me
Speaking words of wisdom, let it be
And in my hour of darkness
She is standing right in front of me
Speaking words of wisdom, let it be
Let it be, let it be
Whisper words of wisdom, let it be

darkness.line: Go on and ask the prince of darkness
stanza: You probably seen me sleepin out by the railroad tracks
Go on and ask the prince of darkness
What about all that smoke come from the stack
Sometimes I kill myself a jackal suck out all the blood
Steal myself a station wagon driving through the mud

darkness.line: And that I see a darkness
stanza: And that I see a darkness
And that I see a darkness
And that I see a darkness
And that I see a darkness
And did you know how much I love you
Is a hope that somehow you
Can save me from this darkness?
This is a waltz
Thinking about our bodies
What they mean
For our salvation
With only the clothes
That we stand up in
Just the ground
On which we stand
Is the darkness
Ours to take?
Bathed in lightness
Bathed in heat

darkness.line: Make my way through this darkness
stanza: Can't see nothing in front of me
Can't see nothing coming up behind
Make my way through this darkness
I can't feel nothing but this chain that binds me
Lost track of how far I've gone
How far I've gone, how high I've climbed
On my back's a sixty pound stone
On my shoulder, a half-mile line

darkness.line: Cause out on the edge of darkness
stanza: Cause out on the edge of darkness
There rides a peace train
Oh, peace train take this country
Come take me home again
She is like a cat in the dark, and then
She is the darkness
She rules her life like a fine skylark, and when
The sky is starless

darkness.line: Sometimes, I sit up in the darkness
stanza: Sometimes, I sit up in the darkness
And I watch my baby as she sleeps
Then I climb in bed and I hold her tight. I just lay there awake in the middle…
Thinking 'bout the wreck on the highway (Oh-oh)

darkness.line: I crawled deep into some kind of darkness
stanza: Well, I put my heart and soul, babe
I put 'em high up on a shelf
Yeah, right next to that faith
The faith that I'd lost in myself
I went down into the desert city
Yeah, just tryin' so hard to shed my skin
I crawled deep into some kind of darkness
Lookin' to burn out every, every trace of who I'd been
